description: Default PERF finding bounds. Conservative: tuned to fire on clear evidence only. Contract/pack/config may override.

scan_amplification.rationale: scanning >5x the produced bytes indicates missing pruning/filtering

pruning_min.rationale: scanning >50% of partitions means the partition key misses the predicate

exchange_amplification.rationale: shuffle >3x input is a redistribution-heavy plan

skew_ratio.rationale: max/median task duration >4x across >=4 tasks is a hot key or data skew

spill_ratio.rationale: spilling >50% of peak memory indicates sustained memory pressure

queue_share.rationale: queueing >30% of wall time is contention, not execution

remote_io_ratio.rationale: remote reads >50% of input bytes is an I/O bound workload

materialize_count.rationale: 3+ materializations in one plan suggests repeated intermediate work
